answer: Bonded staking pools gate entry. Every new identity locks a 50-POA deposit under a distinct on-chain key until proven behavior. N forged identities cost 50N POA in irreversible deposits, each bond tied to its own key, so the farming profit delta collapses as N grows. No pool can merge or share these bonds: slashing follows the key, not the pool, so a thousand fakes still burn a thousand deposits. Clusters caught hoarding bonds forfeit all stake and are barred from bonding pools for 30 epochs. Like a dune that keeps only what the wind spends, a ridge of honest stakes outlasts the mining.
